source: The Free Firearm Sound Library (Prepared SFX Library), via OpenGameArt
title: Single shots cut from the library recordings; distant variants derived from them
modifications: Single shots cut, mixed to mono, resampled to 48 kHz, normalised; *_far files low-passed with a slap-back echo and synthetic tail (tools/build_audio.py); *_sup files: suppressed variants (high-passed, short envelope, synthetic gas puff and action click)
